items.abstract: <jats:p>RuO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> single crystals were obtained by evaporation of PbO from Pb<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>Ru<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>O<jats:sub>6.5</jats:sub> at high temperatures and were verified as good standards for WDS analysis. They were used for the investigation of phase equilibria and the extent of solid solubility in the RuO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>–TiO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> system by WDS quantitative microanalysis. The solid solubility at 1350 °C was determined to be 16.5% TiO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> in RuO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> and 13.5% RuO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> in TiO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>.</jats:p>
title: The extent of solid solubility in the RuO<sub>2</sub>–TiO<sub>2</sub> system
